company.name: Hyundai Electric & Energy Systems Co Ltd
company.description: HD Hyundai Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electrical equipment in South Korea, North America, rest of Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and internationally. The company offers power and distribution transformers, gas insulated and MV/LV switchgears, high-voltage and low-voltage motors, generator, and MV/LV circuit breakers. It also provides marine solutions, such as marine switchgears, distribution transformers, and rotating machines; battery energy storage system; greentric products comprising SF6-Free GIS, natural ester/synthetic oil-immersed power transformer, engine mounted generators, permanent magnet shaft generators, IE4LV motors, and dry air eco switchgears under the GREENTRIC brand. In addition, the company operates industrial IoT-based application platform; and provides energy solution, and assets management solution. The company was formerly known as Hyundai Electric & Energy Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to HD Hyundai Electric Co., Ltd. in March 2023. HD Hyundai Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.

company.name: Breville Group Ltd
company.description: Breville Group Limited engages in the design, development, marketing, and distribution of small electrical kitchen appliances in the Americas, the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers appliances for the kitchen, such as slow cookers, kettles, and fry pans, as well as living room, laundry and bedroom, including irons, vacuums, heaters, electric blankets, and fans. The company also provides coffee machines, espresso, filter coffee, cooking, accessories, and design products; and toasters, coffee grinders, and home espresso equipment. In addition, it operates beanz.com, a digital marketplace for connecting consumers with specialty coffee from roasters; ChefSteps, a platform for home cooks; and Breville+, a companion application. Further, the company distributes coffee machines. It sells its products under the Breville, Sage, Oracle, the Craft Collection, Eye Q, Joule, Baratza, LELIT, beanz, ChefSteps, Kambrook, Aquaport, Cli-mate, the Luxe Precision Brewer, and Nespresso brand names. The company was formerly known as Housewares International Limited and changed its name to Breville Group Limited in November 2008. It was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Alexandria, Australia.

company.name: Daesang Corp
company.description: Daesang Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufacture seasonings and food additives products in Korea, Asia, the United States, Europe, Oceania, and Africa. It operates through Food and Material segments. The company offers general food products, including bean pastes and seasonings; agro-fishery food, such as vinegar and fish sauce; and fresh food products comprising Kimchi and tofu, western food, deli, and frozen food. It also provides food ingredients, such as starch used for food, paper, textile, and construction materials; and sweeteners used in alcohol drinks, beverages, confectionery, baking, and other industrial areas. In addition, the company offers bio-ingredients, including flavor enhancers, amino acids, and microalgae-based products used in food, dietary supplements, functional food, animal nutrition, pet food, and pharmaceutical industries. Further, it engages in trade and real estate activities. The company also exports various bio-ingredient products to approximately 80 countries under the Miwon brand. Daesang Corporation was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
